thought.text: Kaggle terbuka. Sekarang saya cek halaman register — apakah ada captcha, dan opsi login apa saja.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 240 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -30
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900})
    pg.goto("https://www.kaggle.com/account/login",wait_until="domcontentloaded",timeout=90000)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    print("URL:",pg.url)
    print("BODY:",pg.inner_text("body")[:600].replace("\n"," | "))
    for inp in pg.locator("input").all()[:6]:
        print("input:",inp.get_attribute("name"),inp.get_attribute("type"))
    print("iframe:",[f.url[:70] for f in pg.frames if f!=pg.main_frame])
    print("captcha script:",pg.evaluate("""()=>[...document.scripts].some(s=>(s.src||'').match(/recaptcha|turnstile|hcaptcha/))"""))
    b.close()
PY
